subject: general
question: According to Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS), BPL (Below Poverty Line) person aged 60 years or above are entitled to a monthly pension of _______ up to 79 years of age as of October 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 200.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **I**ndira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)

 
 
• The Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme is a non-contributory old-age pension scheme
 
• It covers Indians who are 60 years and above and live below the poverty line.
 
• All IGNOAPS beneficiaries receive a monthly pension of **Rs. 200**
 
• Those** 80 years and above** receive a monthly pension amount of** Rs.500.​**
 
 

Features of Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme:

 
• Under IGNOAP scheme, senior citizens of India will receive monthly pension.
 
• **Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme is a **non-contribution pension.
 
• It means that the beneficiary does not have to contribute any amount to receive the pension.

Eligibility Criteria:

 
• ** The age of the applicant** should be 60 years or higher. (It is applicable for both male & female).
 
• Applicant must belong to household living below poverty line according to the criteria prescribed by the Government.
 
• **Applicant must be destitute and having** no regular source of financial support form family members or any other sources is eligible for old age pension.
 
• BPL widows and BPL persons with severe and multiple disabilities in the age group of 60 -79 years are not eligible for this scheme.
